title: Agent Manifest v1
description: SSOT for agent (.claude/agents/<name>.md) frontmatter. Mirrors the official Claude Code subagent frontmatter spec (16 fields, verified 2026-08-25 against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) plus repo-local portability/handoff fields. Agents have no applies_when (LLM-routed) — they activate via directive description. Refs: docs/audit/2026-08-24-agent-harness-readiness.md

name.description: kebab-case identifier. Must equal agent file name (without .md).

description.$comment: P1: minLength 1 (PoC tolerant). P2~ strict requires >=40 chars + directive style ('Use PROACTIVELY when ...') for LLM router accuracy. Validated by validate-skill-frontmatter.sh.

model.$comment: Model alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, inherit) or full model id (e.g. claude-opus-5). Optional; defaults to inherit.

tools.description: Allowed tool names. Empty array = no tools (analysis-only). Absent = inherit harness default.

version.description: Semantic version. Optional in P1, required at P8 (registry-ready).

produces.description: Artifact types this agent outputs. Vocabulary defined in .claude/agents/_handoff.yml; enforced by scripts/validate-agent-handoff.sh.

consumes.description: Artifact types this agent expects. Vocabulary defined in .claude/agents/_handoff.yml.

effort.description: Effort level while this agent is active; overrides session effort. Model support varies — see .claude/rules/effort-guide.md.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for this agent. NOTE: ignored when the parent session runs in auto mode, and cannot override a parent using bypassPermissions/acceptEdits.

disallowedTools.description: Denylist applied before `tools`. Tool names or MCP patterns only — command-level specifiers such as Bash(gh:*) are NOT supported.

maxTurns.description: Upper bound on agentic turns. Absent = unlimited.

skills.description: Skills preloaded in full at agent startup (progressive disclosure instead of inlining reference material).

mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to this agent — list of names or inline definitions.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this agent; removed when it finishes.

isolation.description: Run in a temporary git worktree.

color.description: Display color in task list and transcript.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted first turn when run as a main-session agent via --agent.
